title: Three conjectures on the first two graph eigenvalues
summary: Let λ₁(G) ≥ λ₂(G) be the two largest adjacency eigenvalues of a finite simple graph G on at least two vertices. We resolve the three conjectures appearing as 1.15–1.17 in Kannan, Kumar and Pragada. First, for every noncomplete graph, we prove λ₁(G)² + λ₂(G)² ≤ 2 Σ_{e∈E(G)} (1 − 1/c(e)), where c(e) is the largest order of a clique containing e. Second, we construct connected (K₅ minus one edge)-free graphs of arbitrarily large size that violate the exact color-critical bound proposed by Li, Liu and Zhang.
